scalar_one_loop_boundary: MSbar singlet scalar determinant at Q^2=2 lambda f^2, other local finite potentials zero there. Evaluate all tree local minima and the first-order scalar vev shift; separately varying those finite coefficients means a different boundary.
threshold: Two original unbroken-phase heavy pole masses are matched as observables. For comparison also hold the original bare two by two Dirac block fixed and record the pole shifts; the unchanged-RGE endpoint applies only to the matched case.
potential: quartic single trace, canonical scalar kinetic term tr(dPhi dPhi)/2, source J=p'_H(H)/||p'_H(H)|| with upstream charged H; no independent finite multi-trace or competing Yukawa source at this matching scale
calibrations: one charged source to tau at MZ
one overall neutral scale to solar central value
freeze both original gains and the two-source composition unless explicitly labelled charged recalibration
correction: One-loop flavour flow is inherited with scalar modes integrated out. Potential and heavy masses are renormalized matching data; no full dynamical flavon UV.
